record.paper_title: Recent developments and open problems in linear series
record.context_brief: Waldschmidt constants for blown-up projective space
record.original_question: Let S = {p1, ..., pr} be distinct points in projective space P^N over an algebraically closed field, let X be the blow-up of P^N at those points, and let L(d,m)=dH-m(E1+...+Er). Waldschmidt defined e(S)=lim_{m→∞} a(S,m)/m, where a(S,m) is the least degree d for which h^0(X,L(d,m))>0. Develop computational or conceptual methods for evaluating, estimating, or bounding the Waldschmidt constant e(S).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field and let $S=\{p_1,\dots,p_r\}$ be a set of $r$ distinct points in projective space $\mathbb{P}^N_k$. Let $\pi: X 	o \mathbb{P}^N$ denote the blow-up of $\mathbb{P}^N$ at the points of $S$, with exceptional divisors $E_1,\dots,E_r$ over $p_1,\dots,p_r$ respectively, and let $H=\pi^*\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^N}(1)$. For integers $d$ and $m\ge 0$, define the line bundle
$$L(d,m) = dH - m(E_1+\cdots+E_r)$$
on $X$, and set
$$a(S,m) = \min\{\, d \in \mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0} : h^0(X, L(d,m)) > 0 \,\},$$
i.e., the least degree $d$ such that there exists a nonzero homogeneous polynomial of degree $d$ on $\mathbb{P}^N$ vanishing to order at least $m$ at every point of $S$. Define the Waldschmidt constant of $S$ by
$$e(S) = \lim_{m	o\infty}  rac{a(S,m)}{m}.$$
(The limit exists because $a(S,m)$ is subadditive in $m$.) The problem is to develop computational or conceptual methods for evaluating, estimating, or bounding $e(S)$ for general configurations of points $S$ in $\mathbb{P}^N$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of computing or bounding Waldschmidt constants $e(S)$ of finite sets of points in projective space is a long-standing open problem. While exact values and bounds have been established in special cases (e.g., points on a conic, generic points in $\mathbb{P}^2$ under Nagata-type conjectures, star configurations, and certain symmetric configurations), no general method is known. The problem remains open in general and is closely connected to the Nagata conjecture and to containment problems between symbolic and ordinary powers of ideals.

status_evidence.title: Symbolic powers of ideals (survey)
status_evidence.snippet: Waldschmidt constants are notoriously difficult to compute and are known only in limited cases; their determination is closely tied to the Nagata conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: General computation of Waldschmidt constants is open.

status_evidence.title: Bounds on Waldschmidt constants
status_evidence.snippet: We establish new bounds on the Waldschmidt constant for configurations of points, but exact values remain unknown in general.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial bounds are available; general evaluation remains open.
